name: samantha
description: Contact Samantha, a separate AI assistant on a remote host. ONLY use when the user EXPLICITLY asks to 'ask Samantha', 'have Samantha do', 'tell Samantha', or 'check with Samantha'. She has her own tools and context and may have Jarvis API access if the remote deployment grants it. Include the task context in the message; she cannot see this chat automatically. Never auto-delegate tasks to her - the user must specifically request Samantha by name.

message.description: Task for Samantha. Include all context she needs - she cannot see your conversation history. Be specific about what response you want back.

session.description: Session ID for conversation context. Use 'jarvis' (default) to continue previous conversations - Samantha will remember prior context. Use unique ID like 'jarvis-research-jan26' for isolated one-off tasks that shouldn't affect main conversation history. Same session = Samantha has context, different session = fresh start.

priority.description: Task priority. 'urgent' = needs immediate attention, 'normal' = standard (default), 'background' = can wait/lower priority.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds. Quick tasks: 30-60s. Complex research: 120s (default). Very long tasks: up to 300s.

test_input.message: Hello, this is a test from Jarvis. Please respond briefly.

availability.setup_hint: Set SAMANTHA_GATEWAY_TOKEN in the active mode env file.
